title: Zesty Crisp Thai Shrimp Som Tum
description: A fresh and light Thai dish featuring sauteed shrimp and amaretti, inspired by the streets of Bangkok, this pescatarian-friendly som tum is a perfect combination of flavors and textures. It is made with a variety of ingredients, including shrimp, amaretti, and vegetables, all mixed together with a zesty dressing.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the shrimp to the skillet and cook until pink and fully cooked, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Remove the shrimp from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil to the skillet and saute the red onion, cucumber, and tomato until the vegetables are tender.
Add the crushed amaretti cookies to the skillet and stir to combine.
In a small bowl, whisk together the fish sauce, lime juice, chili flakes, and salt.
Pour the dressing over the vegetables and cookies in the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the cooked shrimp back to the skillet and stir to combine with the vegetables and dressing.
Transfer the som tum to a serving platter and sprinkle with chopped peanuts.
